transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I've been having a really hard time lately with focusing, especially when it comes to listening to people when they talk directly to me. I get distracted so easily by every little thing, and I've also been feeling really restless and fidgety all the time.
Do you also often act on impulse, like interrupting others, blurting out answers, or having trouble waiting your turn?
No, I don't really experience those specific behaviors. I don't usually find myself interrupting others or having a hard time waiting my turn.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Combined Presentation), Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Inattentive Presentation)], but the patient denied key impulsivity symptoms such as interrupting others and difficulty waiting their turn. That makes Combined Presentation less likely, leaving Predominantly Inattentive Presentation as the best fit given the prominent inattention and distractibility.
